text:
Mae G: Quick kickoff  SEO + webinar ops for launch. Need owners for: keyword prioritization, JSON-LD schema, sitemap + canonicals, redirect rules, internal linking map, and webinar form routing to sales. Who's in?

Santiago: I'll lead the keyword map and content priorities. initial focus: "llm inference at scale", "low-latency llm serving", "inference cost per token". will flag intent and suggest H1/H2.

Olivia: I'll handle JSON-LD (Product + FAQ + Event) and OpenGraph. prefer injecting JSON-LD in page head via CMS partial. Event schema for webinar + registrationAction.

Rosalind: I'll run the full crawl and produce old->new CSV for redirects. recommend 301 for permanent moves, 302 for temporary experiments. will include nginx examples and a status_code column.

Miguel: I'll draft the internal linking CSV with pillar->cluster relationships and CTA anchors. sample: `/blog/gpu-benchmarks,/docs/dedicated-capacity,Compare Dedicated Pools`

Mae G: Webinar form: hidden field `product_interest` + GTM event to populate SFDC queue (dedicated vs hosted). @Rosalind can you wire GTM? Also ensure UTMs are captured.

seo-bot: Crawl summary: 243 pages scanned, 19 404s, 12 missing meta descriptions. Report in /drive/seo/launch-2025.

Olivia: JSON-LD snippet I'll use for webinar head: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Launch Webinar","startDate":"2025-05-12T16:00:00Z","url":"https://www.redwood.inference/webinar","offers":{"@type":"Offer","url":"https://www.redwood.inference/webinar/register","price":"0"}}

Santiago: Top-10 priority pages list will be shared tonight. content team to do 200-300 word intros for those pages to match intent.

Rosalind: Redirect CSV ETA: tomorrow morning. GTM mapping doc after that. Will include canonical header recommendations.

Mae G: Timeline: schema + OG by Wed EOD, keywords by Wed night, redirects + link map by Thu. Review Fri 10am, then PR merge for sitemap/canonical. Ping me for engineering blockers. :thumbsup:
